treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Kingdom of Spain for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2003)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 55. | Spain | 13.07.2001 | 03.09.2003 | 15.12.2004 ( est/eng ) | 28.12.2004 | 01.01.2005 | 01.01.2023
source_title: EE-ES Convention 2003 with Protocol (Riigi Teataja, est/eng) + MoF MFN notices

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

rates.article: Article 11(2) as modified by Protocol VII (MFN)
rates.quote: Protocol VII: "If in any Convention ... signed after the date of signature of this Convention by Estonia and a third State which is a member of the [OECD] ..., Estonia agrees to exempt interest arising in Estonia, other than interest mentioned in paragraph 3, or to lower rate of tax on interest than that provided for in paragraph 2, then such exemption or lower rate shall automatically apply under this Convention ..." ; Estonian MoF: "From 1 January 2016 the state of residence has the exclusive right to tax interest based on the most-favoured nation clause in Article VII of the Protocol of the Convention between Estonia and Spain, which was triggered by the Amending Protocol of the Convention between Estonia and Switzerland effective from the same date."

rates.article: Article 12(2) as modified by Protocol VIII (MFN)
rates.quote: Protocol VIII: "If in any Convention ... signed after the date of signature of this Convention by Estonia and a third State which is a member of the [OECD] ..., Estonia agrees to a definition of royalties which excludes any rights or property referred to in paragraph 3 or to exempt royalties arising in Estonia from Estonian tax on royalties or to lower rates of tax than those provided for in paragraph 2, such definition, exemption or lower rates shall automatically apply under this Convention ..." ; Estonian MoF: "From 1 January 2016 the state of residence has the exclusive right to tax royalties and the term "royalties" does not contain a reference to the payments for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment based on the most-favoured nation clause in Article VIII of the Protocol of the Convention between Estonia and Spain, which was triggered by the Amending Protocol of the Convention between Estonia and Switzerland effective from the same date."

ppt.quote: Synthesised text (fin.ee): "The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Convention: ... a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted ... if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ..." ; Estonia Art. 35(7)(b) notification 01.06.2022 lists "48 Spain 01.06.2022"; MoF table: MLI effective from 01.01.2023.

notes: Interest: original 10% cap (Art. 11(2)); bank-loan interest exclusive from 2005-01-01 (MFN via EE-NL protocol), and all interest exclusive from 2016-01-01 (MFN via EE-CH protocol) per Estonian MoF. Royalties: original 5% equipment / 10% other superseded from 2016-01-01 (residence-only). Spanish-side confirmation of the MFN effects not checked. Interest exemptions Art. 11(3): governments/central banks/export-promotion institutions; credit-sale interest. Protocol VI: limitation on benefits for holding companies (Arts 10-13 reliefs denied unless substantive business or CA agreement). No MLI Art. 8.
unverified: Spanish-side application of interest/royalty MFN not confirmed from a Spanish source
